character.name:
A terrifying ancient predator known as the Thornmaw Ravager.
A massive beast that prowls on four powerful legs, resembling a twisted fusion of a wolf, reptile, and forest monster. Its body is covered in dark bark-like armor plates mixed with patches of coarse black fur and glowing moss. Long jagged thorns protrude from its spine all the way to the tail, giving it a brutal silhouette.
The creature’s head is large and low to the ground with an oversized jaw filled with uneven glowing fangs. Multiple smaller eyes glow dim amber along the sides of the skull, allowing it to see in every direction. Thick black saliva constantly drips from its mouth, sizzling slightly when it touches the ground.
Its front legs are enormous and muscular with hooked claws designed for crushing prey, while the back legs are leaner and built for sudden explosive speed. The tail is long and whip-like with thorny growths and glowing fungal veins pulsing beneath the skin.
The beast appears partially corrupted by ancient forest magic:


Small roots move beneath the skin


Mushrooms and moss grow from wounds


Green particles leak from its breathing


Parts of the body faintly glow in darkness


Idle animation ideas:


Slow aggressive breathing


Tail twitching unpredictably


Saliva dripping from jaws


Eyes blinking independently


Thorn spikes slightly expanding and retracting


Attack animation ideas:


Brutal lunging bite


Ground-pouncing slam


Tail whip attack


Roar releasing glowing spores


Color palette:


Dark forest green


Black fur


Rotten brown bark


Toxic glowing green


Amber eyes


Bone-white teeth and claws


Style:


Dark fantasy monster


Heavy intimidating silhouette


Designed for a pixel art boss enemy or dangerous wilderness predator in an action RPG or survival game
